cards.mood: The piece opens with a meditative and solitary atmosphere, establishing a sense of vast stillness.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a warm, resonant baritone timbre that carries a gentle, breathy texture in the lower register and a clear, emotive quality in the upper range.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing sparse, resonant chords in the intro and evolving into flowing arpeggios and fuller block chords as the song progresses, remaining present until the final fade.
